title: Commit-Bound AST Cache Invalidation and Stale Index Cleanup
description: Record active Git commit HEAD in SQLite .engram/index.db metadata; in ensure_fresh(), detect commit drift and invalidate stale AST records; add engram clean --cache subcommand to purge index cache while preserving user memories.
prompt:
Implement commit-bound cache invalidation and stale index cleanup in Engram:
1. Record the active Git commit HEAD in the SQLite .engram/index.db meta table.
2. In ensure_fresh(), check whether the current repository HEAD matches the cached commit hash; trigger invalidation of stale file records if commit drift is detected.
3. Implement the 'engram clean --cache' subcommand to safely purge the AST SQLite database while preserving .engram/memories.json.
4. Write integration tests in tests/commit_cache_invalidation_test.rs verifying that commit drift triggers ensure_fresh() cache invalidation. Confine all changes strictly to authorized files (src/compiler.rs, src/analyzer.rs, src/main.rs, and tests/commit_cache_invalidation_test.rs). Do NOT modify Cargo.toml or unrelated modules.
5. Verify using 'cargo check --offline' and 'cargo test --offline --lib compiler::tests && cargo test --offline --test commit_cache_invalidation_test'.

L2_unit_tests.command: cargo test --offline --lib compiler::tests && cargo test --offline --test commit_cache_invalidation_test
